hardNegativeRule: At least max(25% of partition queries, 25) queries must have two or more reviewed hard negatives; this pack reviews two judged negative candidates for every query.
unjudgedDiagnosticPolicy: mixed_distractor opposite-language documents remain outside qrels and are not converted to grade 0.
morphologyDefinition: Not applicable to EN; mandatory EN slices are exact_term_identifier, paraphrase, adjacent_topic, and entity_disambiguation.
reviewRowsCanonicalization: UTF-8 JSONL bytes in questions.jsonl order, one compact JSON object per line, LF after the final record; the recorded SHA-256 covers these exact bytes.
reviewRowsSerialization: JSON.stringify object order as committed; no re-sorting or whitespace normalization during verification.
